lines: When the midnight bell dissolves into the night,
The queen of death reigns, deep in the forest.
Unable to even play as a mere jester,
Incomplete, empty, I wander uncertainly.
Kneel, and uncover the coffin,
Grasp that dried-up hand and kiss it.
People would call it immoral,
But, open your eyes, let your voice reach me,
In the curse of love.
Tonight, enchanted by the demon, let us dream (an irresistible, sweet dream);
I long to reach you (and take you away),
As fragrant memories rises.
Even your sunken eyes, your withered skin (burning desires and the stench of decay),
Are still lovely and dear,
As I call out your name, Roxanne.
Temptation, cruelty, the serpent of seduction,
Wrapped in thorns, it deceives and steals.
The [White Believers], unaware of themselves,
Scream for judgment, administering poison.
Only I could see it,
You simply loved everything too much.
Those who do not possess, would not tolerate it—
With just a glance, just a word,
You could take everything away.
If anger and hatred can bring you what you seek (even this sorrow is dear to me),
Those who brought harm (those worms),
I can crush them before your eyes.
The empty tomorrows are no longer needed   (turning away from the dazzling sunlight),
At our ball under the moon's shadow, let us waltz together!
In the midst of madness and your murderous intent (like a ritual, yes, like an offering),
I have become a broken doll (taking everything, even the sorrow)
Return it… forgive me… (even if we can't go back, I wish time could stand still)
In the echoing forest, darkness giggled softly (now, malice has chuckled)
Let us two—
Freeze our tears, and dream,
As I long to reach you (deep underground),
And there's nowhere to return to.
Even your sunken eyes, your withered skin (burning desires and the stench of decay),
Are still painfully lovely.
Take me away, Roxanne.

lines: Aching in deep azure, at the feet of the Idea
I am wearied — (I bud and sprout)
Deceiving perfection, in the false delight of god
I am swallowed down — (I offer up the fruit)
Driven by longing I drive the wedge; even prostrate, what I sip is the maker's blood
Awaiting a shallow wound at last, a beast that soothes a thirst that cannot wither
If it is what you desire, then you have only to create it
This empty husk without an "Original"
Yes — thousands, tens of thousands of idols
Touch me — this amber-colored skin; see, the same as a human's
-Memory of the idol- "Mémoire des idoles"
I will give you a bewitching kiss
But I am myself, a rose of confession
Ah, will you finish me now?
Swiftly write the rest onto fresh paper
I want to go to that faint pool of sunlight
Fodder of a clumsy, tawdry tale — frantically I bite the faithless fruit
Made into a shoddy night-tale, as if a blackened corpse
Because someone wishes it, that is why you exist here
Without originality, no "Original," the bloom is plucked away
Yes — an idol of mere outlines and patter
Whisper it, in a thousand-hued voice; see, the same as the other children
-A loveless confession- "Mots d'amour fragiles"
An unfulfilled wish makes its dreamer a captive
Then I too will take up this shell of self-torment
Ah, is it a sin to escape?
Please, with this hand, let me lay down that pen
I want to live in the world of that pale blue bird
If you would, please give me a name; see, unlike the other children
-The idol's true name- "Le vrai nom de l'idole"
A tireless mimicry-play, all of it refuse
But I am myself — yes, I do exist
Feel it, this amber-colored skin; see, the same as a human's
-Memory of the idol- "Mémoire des idoles"
I will give you a bewitching kiss
Now I too will take it up, a self-bound rose
Ah, will you turn me to ash?
Please, erase my memories too, sweep them all away
I only wish, at least, to pass on like a human

lines: In a forest of indifferent buildings

lines: Entwining desire, a gaze steeped in heat
A splendid reward — you want it, don't you?
Come now, kneel and serve me
This starved body, unraveling, melting white
I'll teach you well: that sin itself is the pleasure
Once bound by night's chains, there is no turning back
In the sea of vice thick with sweet perfume, I go on drowning
A doll born where life and death were mingled
The bud opens now, and good and evil lose their meaning
Lips drawn close, wet and gleaming, bewitching
The tip of the tongue goes numb, turning into rapture
Once you have found the ripened fruit, there is no stopping
Past the burning thorns, lured in deeper, to the very depths
Laughing within the mirror, casting off a half-broken reason
What I want is you — I go on craving the forbidden taste

lines: In a color-faded room, a silence clings fast
Shards of the shattered mirror throw back an ugly form
The lonely heart at last woke the beast
Behind me, the king of darkness descends
If I offer up everything, will my wish come true?
Let me violate the soul and spill the blood
The red that paints my fingertips is a rusted scent
Ah, the crimson flower
This body, given love by the true god, is eternal
Screams and sobs alike, let me offer them all to you
From the black wound carved into my back
the beauty of truth is born
If you point and name me a cursed creature
then reveal here the miracle of light
What can be known from an empty husk's shape?
A world that violates the soul and laughs
With prayer brimming with grotesque love
there can be no salvation
If I offer up everything, will my wish come true?

lines: Stolen emotions — I feel no pain at all
A cold birdcage; tonight again I crave the singing
Thin silk torn away
dreaming of the day I am stained with blood
Fingertips brushing the places left wanting
began to writhe like a serpent
The familiar curtain is a prison's cage
A Requiem sung for my sake
Scattered limbs
If you, who toy with me on a whim,
should let a beautiful smile rise to your lips
then comes the moment I break
On the tongue that gouges the burning wound
I scream and pant, calling forth madness
A warped bond — teach me despair
It presses me to brand it upon my heart
Hatred and love, set back to back,
sway like waves and go falling down
Fingertips brushing the places left wanting
claw and clutch, craving a sob
A paradise past all return, a fading awareness
A Requiem sung for my sake
Lalala...
In the darkness, the distant whisper is the scream you left behind
Held in your arms, I simply crumble and fall

lines: The rose you touched
learned shame at its own form,
and will wither away in vain—
my finest masterpiece, my beloved girl.
Clad in a velvet dress,
a noble smile, within the castle of darkness,
the blood that moistens pale skin
lures you to the border of dream and reality.
I need no narrow gate of God;
what I want is a girl shining bewitchingly.
Becoming the goddess of slaughter,
I will fall into slavery.
Look—the doll's head goes rolling away,
bounding high down the dark staircase.
Papa taught me everything—
how to scoop it up,
and whether I'll sing it out in delight.
Ah, this mad love is brimming over,
a world where nothing is ever right.
I gave it all,
how to scoop it up,
and whether I'll sing it out in delight.
Deep within a distant consciousness
lie a blue sky and a gently blowing wind,
a garden where dazzling light blooms,
tears spill and trace down my cheeks—
what is this?
You need not think of anything at all,
just behave as your heart desires.
If someday you notice it was a sin,
you'll go mad, unable to move—won't you?
Look—a jet-black veil fills the room,
a sweet fragrance takes command of the body.
Papa carried everything away,
even the sorrowful memories,
even the crucifix of prayer.
Ah, behind a chained door,
tonight again I kindle demons and call a sacrifice.
I shall give you everything—
the roses that adorn your hair,
and the requiem of forgiveness too.
Clad in a velvet dress,
a noble smile, within the cage of darkness,
the blood that moistens pale skin
sets my heart to dancing.
I do not fear God's judgment;
what I want is a girl shining bewitchingly.
Becoming the goddess of slaughter,
I will fall into slavery.
Look—someone's head goes rolling away,
bounding high down the dark staircase.
Papa taught me everything—
how to scoop it up,
and whether I'll sing it out in delight.
Ah, this mad love is brimming over,
a world where nothing is ever right.
I gave it all,
how to scoop it up,
and whether I'll sing it out in delight.

lines: Ah, why was I ever born into this world—
when all of it is so unfair, and I can only live
clumsily, and barely at all…
Ah, the whispering demon says: “If it is light you want,
just seize it—with the strength of your own hands.”
The flower dwelling in my breast, if it feeds on sorrow and blooms,
within these frightened eyes a bewitching fire is mirrored.
From far away, someone's scream.
Blood streaming down my cheeks.
And you, crouched before my eyes.
If I could carve you like this for all eternity,
could I fall into pleasure even as I hate?
From inside my head, the droning cry of insects.
At the fingertips that sweep them away, a bewitching fire.
Ah, why am I even here?
If only someone had wanted me, I might have been saved.
The flower dwelling in my breast, if it feeds on sorrow and blooms,
in eyes that shine with joy, a bewitching fire blazes.
My torn-away heart writhes, warped and misshapen.

lines: The moon pierces the madder-red sky, staining you as I gaze upward.
In the evening-calm wind, the beat of fairy wings, a hoarse voice.
The feast begins; the twittering darkness will surely make you its captive.
So you won't be afraid, close your eyes and take my hand.
The king of night smiles, dyed in blue; you, whom I gazed at, cast your eyes down.
~I'll give you one fragment of my heart, so please don't let go~
Gathering the light that tangles in your hair, let us walk into the deep forest.
A swan and a prince cross the lake; the water's surface trembles.
That is a tale from long, long ago—roses still blooming at a weathered castle.
What the spell of sleep led to was a counterfeit love.
The dying feast; even if the twittering darkness should someday lead me astray,
at your utterly altered form I close my eyes and take your hand.
Keep me by your side, always…

lines: I think of you — death, this blood-stained land
As I wander across it, with this power that guides

Unable to tell you, the anguish within my breast
Though we were never meant to be joined — ah

Snatch me away, keep death far from me

receive this blessing (let us receive it)
and dream, seeking the holy land

torn by anguish (torn apart)
and still I seek that far country
Now, I beckon it near

Upon me, who knows no joy, the rain falls

Called a loathsome daughter and cast aside
the girl had no way but to curse herself and live
(Let me offer up this soul — the road that leads to the underworld)
(From the thorns that coil around me, crimson drips)
(In exchange, just one thing — carry that person to the light)
Break the chains of darkness (I do not wish it)
The light I cast (I want to give it)

I think of you — this earth where flowers bloom

An aching fragrance draws out my tears
(An aching resonance — that song draws out my tears)

(Even between dream and waking, your form is not there)

lines: Who decided this — was it all arranged in advance?

lines: A sigh and tears of honey, dragging a broken cocoon

An illusion that can never be undone
Repeats, and goes on and on
Until death opens its eyes!

This half-rotted body of yours
I stitch it up, stab by stab,
gather the moonlight and wind it round the needle,
and the soul wakes, reaching for the one it loves,
walking into night, without end,
lu-la-la, lu-la-la, sing.
Those blue, clouded eyes
I set to twitching, tick by tick;
the pattern of red wounds dripping down your breast
is like a butterfly that squirmed in the dark of night —
ah, beautiful princess of the night.
Life run out, dyed in death, crossing the hill,
to the old nest of our love, where he must be waiting;
hazy yet distant, deep in memory,
this is a tale of after a hundred years had passed.
Even if your life should burn away to nothing,
don't be afraid — I'll peel you and sew you anew.
I want no thanks; I only long to smell the rot,
to touch the sweetly ripened pomegranate.
The wounds that run down your back, too,
I stitch them up, stab by stab;
the forest trees, a veil of dripping spider-webs,
raised overhead, the white of our vow,
the eternal bell I play rings far and low.
A pale, withered hand
lifts softly toward the sky;
the fate of a clockwork doll —
there's no starting over.
The price and the recompense are never equal.
Say, beautiful princess of the night.
Rotted and fallen, steeped in death, crossing the hill,
to the old nest of our love — but he is here no longer.
hazy yet distant, deep in memory,
this is a tale of after a hundred years had passed.
Even if one day my life should burn away,
don't be afraid — I will never leave you.
The book of black sorcery, its hidden words —
gather here and devour the soul.
A parade of corpses, march on toward paradise;
the feast of dreams, raving in delight, is necrophilia.
Because this love is pure, I long to feel the rot,
to touch the sweetly ripened pomegranate.
Even if one day my life should burn away,
don't be afraid — I will never leave you.
The book of black sorcery, its hidden words —
gather here and devour the soul.
I'll never let you go now — my dear little playthings,
I'll offer you everything; devour this body of mine.

Deep, shallow, strong — a whispering
that runs wild and echoes within me;
a wrought mirror of gold and silver,
night after night, praise and extol my beauty.
Everyone, look at me;
gazes swim across my skin,
a sigh spilling from red lips.
The witch's scheme is the apple's plot —
"I could let you have a taste, but... just kidding."
A single bite, and consciousness fades away;
let me teach that foolish witch a lesson.
"Mirror, mirror, who in all the world is the fairest of all?"
My madness — look — is whirling up;
I'll give you punishment until you're burned away.
The more you beg and plead, the more the dark aches out;
you'd best kneel down, upon the needle.
Grieving and sorrowing, the dwarves murmur:
"Please, dear prince, touch the princess."
Touching her white shoulder, he calls, pressing lips to hers;
from long lashes, blue eyes peer out.
Night after night, the witch who questions the mirror
rages madly, her breath all but failing,
muttering words of curse again and again,
bleeding through, she looks up at the night.
"Mirror, mirror, who in all the world is the most foolish of all?"
The witch's body — look — is squirming;
let me set a mark upon that ugly skin.
The more you beg and plead, the more the dark aches out;
a kiss upon the red-hot steel.
My madness is whirling up;
I'll give you punishment until you're burned away.
The more you beg and plead, the more the dark aches out;
you can never escape, for all eternity.
Deep, shallow, strong — a whispering
that goes on seeking within me.
A wrought mirror of gold and silver,
night after night, praise and extol my beauty.

In a castle sealed in mist, unknown to any soul,
three beautiful princesses dwell;
in the still night a tolling bell announces the feast's beginning,
and lured by a bewitching fragrance, pitiful offerings gather.
O chosen sacrifice of this night,
drown yourself in a sweet dream;
give up your all, and here within our arms
we shall grant you the highest pleasure —
offer up your untainted blood.
A demon-slayer who slipped into tonight's feast
has stirred awake the memories of when she lived as a human.
Devouring people, devouring time, she had set her heart aside;
though it should be a life lost together long, long ago,
there is no reason you should live, no chance we could meet,
and though I know it cannot be, my heart trembles still.
Long, long ago —
this is a tale of when she was still human.
The girl had someone she loved in return,
but the two were the son and daughter of rival noble houses;
they could never be allowed to be joined,
so with their deaths the two saw their love through.
Reborn as a demon,
before the girl who had passed thousands of years, the offering appeared —
the very likeness of her beloved,
a cruel trick of fate.
How foolish you are, our little sister —
to have your heart stolen by a mere human.
The meaning of blood that will not mingle with theirs —
surely you understand it.
Our blood becomes poison to humans;
if he wants it, then give him your blood.
O young Slusnik,
flee from this place at once;
if you say you cannot kill me,
then... let me protect you.
Through the dark forest, over frozen mountains, the two raced away,
seeking a far-off place where no one's eyes could reach;
for the two who betrayed their kin and betrayed humankind,
what waits is judgment — for we are Pandora's box…
The heart she reclaimed — it is the quickening of a beautiful life;
though I know it cannot be, my heart trembles still.
The two queens left behind vanished from sight,
and the demons' world fell into an age of war.
Meanwhile, the former queen who chose not to drink blood
lost her overwhelming power;
hunted now by both demons and humans,
yet rumor says she is guarded by two mighty demons of unknown identity.

In this reclining body, consciousness grows distant;
grating noise — I am falling.
Into the dark where I hold another self,
I learn a cruel pain, and tears spill over.
Counting the wounds that multiply, my grieving smile twists;
a spent, soundless wailing melts hollow into the dark.
Before I know it, I nestle close to a sweet Thanatos;
the nearer I draw, the deeper the wounds are gouged.
Instinct aching awake, a sweetly coloring voice,
a loveless tenderness — I fall, on and on, without end.
How many memories must I carve away?
Unable to resist, I give my body up to it.
The act of washing off defilement, meaningless, has warped;
no one will ever teach it — this is all of "me."
To live, to die — not even knowing which,
we overlap and melt away into the dark;
the glass I thrust into the lying grown-ups
casts back a false light and shatters.
To live, to die — not even able to choose,
a thing shared between two, vanishing fleetingly into the void;
my frozen heart refused to know,
for the world I was given is all there is.
Before I know it, I nestle close to a sweet Thanatos;
the nearer I draw, the deeper the wounds are gouged.
Instinct aching awake, a sweetly coloring voice,
a loveless tenderness — I fall, on and on, without end.

Roses scattering and dancing wild bloom proud upon my breast;
the thorn that serves up evil is a sweet, soft pain.
The holy sacrifices, a scheme to be reveled in;
fearing neither sin nor punishment, because you are here.
Bound together, we begin to go mad, and morality shatters too;
a distance where we cannot touch is fine — for I want to feel your heart.
Before highborn me, a servant kneels;
look — one, and then another,
wishing to be loved.
The desire everyone holds at the bottom of their heart
is just one, yes, only one:

that person's mark upon my white skin —
a forbidden love, but even so, it's fine.

The brother who calls to me more than anyone is the only one;
hidden in the shadows of a moonlit night, we're drawn together.

will I find joy in this passion, I wonder?
If the future can't be seen, then throw it away;
tears above all are the droplets that carry feeling.
Even if we cannot touch, if our eyes meet,
the warmth and meaning pass between us — so there's nothing to fear.

in what voice will she sing?
A pure and proper lady,
enthralled by poison.

sin and punishment overlapping, a shadow that colors you.

just a little, a little more,
like a moon that waxes then wanes;
grant my wish and come quickly to fetch me,
give me a kiss right now,
please, before I break apart.
A fleeting dream, a Cantarella held within,
I live by devouring cruel memories;
that person's heat upon my white skin —
ah, I want to feel it, this endless sin.
The more I go on living in search of paradise,
the less I can remain a foolish child;
in the endless night, a body that sways and struggles,
I set my claws and, only, began to crave.
The brother who resonates with me more than anyone is the only one;

love, sung as a lie;
a pure and proper lady
commits the forbidden.

Deep in the forest, in the abyss where darkness lurks,
another me has fallen into sleep.
Born under twin stars,
we cried out on the same night;
apart from the color of the blood we shared,
in nothing were we alike.
Rose-colored lips and ebony hair swaying,
a beautiful voice — everything,
all that was given, was not given to me.
Behind sunken eyes, a shard of a shadow that twitches.
Let no one look upon this form of mine
(this utterly changed form)
swept away in a whirlpool of malice
(into a blurred dream);
the star shines on her, gleaming tonight
(while I am tormented by the void),
sorrow and murderous intent mingling together
(endlessly we tear at each other).
To a lovely heart, forgiveness is granted;
if I could at least be a flower that blooms,
is it a sin to wish to make it bloom?
Just quietly, hidden in the shadow of the trees,
let us offer up a prayer.
Let no one touch what is within my heart
(this wholly twisted form);
small flowers wither and pile up
(as hollow time passes);
the star shines on her, gleaming tonight
(while you are wrapped in light);
hatred is a monster that can't be restrained
(you come to know your sin).
A fairy drifting and glowing
(scattering its radiance),
lamp in hand, it leads astray
(luring you into confusion),
and shatters your reason — in red.
Let no one look upon my rotted form
(this utterly changed form)
swept away in a whirlpool of malice
(into a blurred dream);
the star blesses her and gleams
(while I am tormented by the void),
this body overflowing with joy
(tormented on even in death).
Everyone forgets and fades within the waking dream;
the time of malice is already far away,
the star drifts to a barren land where no one is,
and oblivion and time mingle together.

awaiting the moment of the end

Come, come over here

Rabeti, trabeti, shebetika

Rabeti, trabeti, shebetika

sorina, tsetina, kamiera

lines: Kotokoto — a resonance rings
A dream of surrealism
A gaudy fairy tale, a finale begging for its own bygone age
Harahara — I drown in my own weeping form
Thoughts torn to a thousand shreds drove me on toward the curse
It is everywhere, commonplace
A herd made of everyone's idols
Casting off shame so lightly, they smile
Why is this wide sky so endlessly high and far
It swallows down even the filthiest of feelings
The place I aim for is nowhere to be found
I no longer know what freedom is
I come to want to wound someone — a delusion with no object
Fuwafuwa — the net sways, flitting and crossing, lacewing

Someday, may you reach that burning dream
I am only lit by the light, carving my shadow deeper
With no rails ever laid down for me

laughs from behind a mask

Where does the blame lie? Ah — upon this very body
Someday, may you reach that burning dream

Why is this wide sky so endlessly high and far
It swallows down even the clumsiest of sorrows
The place I aim for is nowhere to be found
I no longer know what freedom is
I come to want to end it all

lines: Rusted steel, a creaking spiral, a castle blooming in the desert

A girl who casts a faint light lies within it

Racing through circuits, wandering with no grasp of the meaning
Tell me
Beneath a sky of dancing ash, there is no history to chase

When those eyes open — a darkness dissolved into cobalt

lines: Slipping through the twilight forest, a secret hideaway where thorns beckon

Kasure goe de ichirinsha ni notta kigurumi raion
Nani mo kamo ga omoidoori nee, sou nan desho?
Kirei na hanataba wo daite matte ite kureru no

Nemuru koto nai fantajii sei naru kotoba no fanfaare
Mita koto nai pikapika no mahou futarikiri no buranko

A parade sets off through a toy box packed with dreams
Balloons of every color, children whirling and dancing through the air
A castle trimmed with red ribbons—leave the escort to me
Fitted with lovely plumes, ringing my white shoes
A ball-balancing ballerina and a friendly elephant and its child—
if they take to the sky they dance round and round; this is a merry circus
A fantasy that never ends, a fanfare ringing through the starry sky
Heart bouncing with anticipation, the door that opens is a jewel box
Pouring in a fluffy heart, kissing the gentle clown
I want you to spirit me out of the forbidden game -Romance-
The parade goes on with the blue bird that spins love
A costumed lion riding a unicycle in a hoarse voice

A fantasy that never sleeps, a fanfare of holy words
Sparkling magic I've never seen, a swing meant just for two
With a secret-tinged charm I hold out my heart

lines: 今日も目が覚めれば お伽の世界が始まる

この胸を貫く
咲き誇る花にも 綺麗なティアラでも
私の中を満たすことは叶わない きっと
心を染めたくて 言葉を求めてる
抗わずに名前を呼んで
もっと私を刻んで
『真実の愛など知りもしない悪魔どもに
白の神の怒りよ 雷と成り落ちよ』
震える肌 血を流して
美しいオブジェ 可愛い鳴き声
恋を教え 夢を与えて
生きる意味をくれたのは
唯一の存在
沸き出る欲望に素直に従うの
それは神の導きだから
と下手な言い訳
何処まで汚れれば 何時まで傷つけば
その微笑みを見せてくれる
未だ答えを知らない
遠い瞳でくちずさむ歌は誰を想ってるの
恋は焦がれ 憎しみは芽吹くのね
咲き誇る花にも 綺麗なティアラでも
私の中を満たすことは叶わない きっと
心を染めたくて 言葉を求めてる
抗わずに名前を呼んで
もっと私を刻んで
痛みを教えて
Kyou mo me ga samereba otogi no sekai ga hajimaru
Dare mo ga emi ukabe ai wo ouka suru no
Hoshii mono ga areba kami no megumi da to tonaete
Jama suru mono areba seigi wo tate ni ubaitoru
Mayoikonda kuro no ouji
Jiyuu wo ubaware tsumetai rouya e
Kuroi kami to akai hitomi ga
Sagesumu you na shisen de
Kono mune wo tsuranuku
Sakihokoru hana ni mo kirei na tiara de mo
Watashi no naka wo mitasu koto wa kanawanai kitto
Kokoro wo sometakute kotoba wo motometeru
Aragawazu ni namae wo yonde
Motto watashi wo kizande
"Shinjitsu no ai nado shiri mo shinai akuma-domo ni

Furueru hada chi wo nagashite
Utsukushii obuje kawaii nakigoe
Koi wo oshie yume wo ataete
Ikiru imi wo kureta no wa
Yuiitsu no sonzai
Wakideru yokubou ni sunao ni shitagau no
Sore wa kami no michibiki da kara
To heta na iiwake
Doko made yogorereba itsu made kizutsukeba
Sono hohoemi wo misete kureru
Mada kotae wo shiranai
Tooi hitomi de kuchizusamu uta wa dare wo omotteru no
Koi wa kogare nikushimi wa mebuku no ne
Sakihokoru hana ni mo kirei na tiara de mo
Watashi no naka wo mitasu koto wa kanawanai kitto
Kokoro wo sometakute kotoba wo motometeru
Aragawazu ni namae wo yonde
Motto watashi wo kizande
Itami wo oshiete
When my eyes open again today, a fairy-tale world begins
Everyone wears a smile, singing the praises of love
If there's something they want, they chant that it's God's grace
If something stands in their way, they seize it with justice as their shield

stripped of his freedom, cast into a cold cell
Black hair and red eyes,
with a gaze as if in scorn,
pierce through this heart of mine
Not with flowers in full bloom, nor with a lovely tiara
can what is inside me be filled—surely not
Wanting to dye my heart, I keep seeking words
Without resisting, call my name
Carve yourself into me, more
"Upon the demons who know nothing of true love,
O wrath of the white god, come down as thunder"
Trembling skin, shedding blood
A beautiful objet, a sweet little cry
Teaching me love, granting me dreams—
the one who gave me a reason to live
was that sole existence
I honestly obey the desire that wells up
because it is God's guidance—
such a clumsy excuse
How far must I be soiled, how long must I wound,
before you show me that smile?
I still don't know the answer
The song you hum with distant eyes—whom are you thinking of?
Love yearns, and hatred buds, doesn't it
Not with flowers in full bloom, nor with a lovely tiara
can what is inside me be filled—surely not
Wanting to dye my heart, I keep seeking words
Without resisting, call my name
Carve yourself into me, more
Teach me pain

lines: Buried in mystery, in the silent sea of trees, a trace of glory: a slumbering fortress
Amid the ash left in the lantern, faintly glimmers the color of a jewel
Even after centuries, still standing proud, an unspoken pride
Loyalty once defied tyranny and left its words behind
If I only wished to wither away
(The flow of time draws close to solitude)
I should have found ease — and yet
I wish it fiercely: to inherit that grace, to pass beyond sorrow
Petals of a white-blooming soul; the tears that gently wet them are a sacred rain
That vow bound tight to my finger — to fulfill it, I keep on sleeping
And in time I awaken, toward eternity
The far-hazed castle of the sky; the wind of faith gathers and goes
To offer up a body ruled by original sin — is that blasphemy?
If the noble one, seeking meaning, walks the road by the guidance of proverbs
vividly it surfaces — the emblem of courage, lodged within the heart
An unseen far end, where rainbows pour down
(Where the stars are bound, the border of the horizon)
Repainting this world anew
Every longing, even the ideal scenery — a place where all can come true
Just as the prophecy written in ancient days foretold, the golden days come once more
The light I held deep in my chest overflows — a resounding song of miracles
And it fills to the brim, toward eternity
From valor toward blessing, the stage turns round
Touching the wings of the spirits, O shimmering word-soul
Petals of a white-blooming soul; the tears that gently wet them are a sacred rain
That vow bound tight to my finger — to fulfill it, I wake from sleep
Just as the prophecy written in ancient days foretold, the golden days come once more
The light I held deep in my chest overflows — a resounding song of miracles
And it fills to the brim, toward eternity
en.src: OCR draft — FairiA ～幻想妖精絵本～

lines: Deep in the woods, when the secret door softly opens
the neighbor beats tiny wings and scatters malice around
Silver droplets trickle down, tracing along the trees
onto my skin, in mischief, they drip so cold
Tickling, just like that day
why was I the one left behind?
O white blizzard, rage and run wild
I am nothing but tears, holding my loneliness close
the eyes of the fairy king who has not yet come—
I let my heart race for them, going mad with longing
the needle of a curse that love gives birth to
Atop a little hill, the sound of those who dance and sing—
horn and bell, a fondly remembered ringing
An unseen form, a voice, the trace of a faint lingering scent
O black water, corrode it all
if it cannot become mine, then everything—
I wish it would just close away
yet no cry of mine will reach
Ah, what to do, what to do — even a nightmare would be fine
even torn to shreds, I would feel no regret
I want to chase it to the very end and seize it
until I break those golden wings …
I gently try to trace the mark carved into me
if it will vanish, then why does it rob me of oblivion?
O white blizzard, rage and run wild
I am nothing but tears, holding my loneliness close
the eyes of the fairy king who has not yet come—
I let my heart race for them, going mad with longing
I cannot forgive; I want to forgive
a writhing passion, a binding fence
if you would sneer that I am a fool
then give me the fruit of death

lines: Dreaming of jade, at the dawn I woke to
the hazy moon-god floats up and smiles
What cannot be replaced is, like sand, simply
slipping through these hands, without a sound
Since when, I wonder, did your figure start to fade from sight?
Held in wings the color of the sky
my childish gaze waited longingly for tomorrow
The story you left behind that night—
tell me how it goes on
Praying to the sunrise that dyes the horizon
I want to fly once more, with you, to the edge of the clouds
I know it is a wish that won't come true — and so, yes, by my own hand
If I open the door, I will praise the world
this dazzling, radiant beauty
The days I longed for wings the color of the sky
now this resolute gaze becomes an angel
The story you left behind that night—

lines: An old picture book and a silver coin

the kitten nestles close, as if worried
chides me with its rough little tongue
and night comes again
That thing, laughing with malice in its hand,
hidden in the shadow of the bed, slipping unseen
[What it lacks is your blood — call out, call its name]
No matter how many times I try, is it no use?
The magic charm won't work
I want to make Mama, who's always angry, disappear—
is a wish like that not allowed?
"Never mind that — pet me instead"
the sleepy kitten nestles close
coaxing me with its little paws
and I grow warm
That thing, wearing a bored face,

claws at your throat, waiting for the moment, someday …]

Peering into the coffin, your eyes

The silver sword you held in one hand—

Don't pierce me yet
the finger that strokes the blade's tip
touch it to my white skin
and let a crimson rose bloom
Bewildered, spellbound, you are mine
I'll teach you even the pleasure of being taken
Ah, you won't be honest

the finger that strokes the blade's tip

and let a crimson rose bloom
Bewildered, spellbound, you are mine

aren't on the surface — they peer into my heart

lines: Called by the wisdom of dawn, the silence now proclaims an ending
Piling up time beyond counting, night and day made equal to eternity
The silver hall has woken from its solitude
Adorned in splendor, words set in rows, flowers of rapture bloom — a song of madness

Behind the cruelty and the cold, hiding its weakness, a heart still childlike

lines: Summer Day — morning pours into a sweltering room

Unable to bear my parched throat, I raise my body
Open shirt, tousled hair — I kissed you
A droplet from the lifted glass falls
Along with the feel of it wetting my bare legs
The taste of melted water — I'd grown used to it somehow — a stagnant everyday
Forgetting even what I once believed, we devour each other
No words are needed, drowning in sin — Seaside Memory
Who was told, and by whom — meaningless from the start
I gaze without meaning to — Romeo laughing on the midsummer shore
The way home walked side by side, looking up at the night sky
The hazy profile of the moon showing through the clouds
Though I feel the warmth in our joined hands
I kept searching for the cause of this unshakable unease
Mingling with the clinging scent of cigarettes, this vague emotion
As the distance closes, at last it lays itself bare
Ghastly yet endearing — a savage instinct
Forgetting even what I once believed, we devour each other
No words are needed, drowning in sin — Seaside Memory
Who was told, and by whom — meaningless from the start
Smiling quietly — the rouge that stained the midsummer shore
The letters written in the sand are washed by the waves
If they must vanish someday, then at least for now —
Again and again I held you fiercely — Seaside Memory
What could be left behind — meaningless from the start
Seen in a daybreak dream — Romeo laughing on the midsummer shore
O distant memory — the rouge of summer

淡い唇 牙にゆるく触れた

Sora ni maiorita namida utsukushiku
Boku wa kanarazu kimi dake mamoru kara
Yoru ni sarawareta tsurugi wa iranai

In gleaming glass sleeps a girl of the white night
not knowing she'll be hunted
Uninvited fingertips, the prayer is brief
a heavy "afterimage of the blade" brushed hard against my wings
You who descended from the sky are beautiful
For the first time, I come to love a human
Enthralled by the night, my sword trembles
until darkness enfolds and steals the heart, like a storm
"The rebel messiah falls"
the prophecy cries out and shudders
Crossing the withered thorns
the little-bird girl, not even knowing the lie
ties a ribbon with a forbidden love
Pale lips brushed gently against fangs
a world sealed in snow freezes over
For the first time, I want to protect a human
even if, losing the light, no miracle remains
stretching white... it will hide you, like a blizzard
Say nothing — it pierced through my chest
even if I offer all of myself, my very life
Descended from the sky, tears so beautiful
because I will surely protect you alone
Snatched away by the night, I need no sword
until flames enfold and take me, as once before...

Fuwafuwa ukabu fuusen

Koko wa fushigi saakasu-dan

Yume mite iru yori kimi wo shibaru risei hodokou
Dare ni nozomare umare nan no tame ni ikiru no
Heru mon ja nai nante
Hito ni iwasenakute ii

Shinkirou ukabi yureru kyou mo kodoku na kokoro
Koko ni tsudoe yo
Anata no naka de saite dare no tame karechiru inochi no hana
Dare no tame ni umarete dare no tame ni warau no
Kami no inai sekai de nozomi mono wo te ni shite

Before a cross of stone,
a gentleman breathes white breath
shedding tears, hollow-eyed,
standing there with a rose
"This way, please" — the glowing lamp of the tent
with a gentle smile, the silver-haired girl beckons
For whose sake are we born, for whom do we weep?
People turn their backs on solitude and wander, seeking love
Look, look, behold 〖the beloved reflected in the mirror〗
gazing, taking my hand, vanishing 〖melting away in a drift〗
A soft, floating balloon —
shall I give you one?
A boy enduring the pain
this is the wondrous circus troupe
"A future that will change someday" — such an uncertain thing
rather than dreaming, let me loose the reason that binds you
Born at whose wish, for what do we live?
It's not as if you'd lose anything —
you need not let others say so
Come, come, behold 〖the one to be loved, reflected in the mirror〗
softly crumbling and vanishing 〖break me, forgive me〗
A mirage floats and sways — a heart lonely again today
Gather here
Blooming within you — for whose sake does this flower of life wither and fall?
For whose sake are we born, for whom do we smile?
In a world without a god, take what you desire in your hand
Look, look, see 〖the nostalgic days reflected in the mirror〗
swaying, vanishing with a prayer 〖melting away in a drift〗

lines: To descend deep, ever deeper, with the faint light
Because you take this hand and gently lead me
Your tone, your face hidden behind a black mask
Today too you seek my warbling song
When you stroke the keys with supple fingers
The faint scent of musk tightens around my heart
Teach me gently (a hidden longing)
For I will let my throat sing out (as if offering sweet words)
A flickering melody (a white little bird)
It comes to command my heart
The burning candle (before it goes out)
Grants me a fever (a passion so fierce it brings vertigo)
And a heartbeat that will not still (I am toyed with)
Intoxicate me in this numbing whirlpool of sound
Swaying, collapsing, into your gentle breast
To whom do you show the feelings you hide behind the mask?
A seed of desire quietly buds within the maiden
A cruel flower, secretly made to bloom crimson

I entwine my white fingers and whisper by your ear
Is it a dream or an illusion? (Or a nightmare?)
Is it a lewd sin? (A punishment I committed, letting loneliness swell)

A captive angel (I cannot resist)
People are drawn to a sacred lie and fall to their ruin

I want to throw everything away and be with you
Teach me gently (a hidden longing)
For I will let my throat sing out (as if offering sweet words)
A flickering melody (a black little bird)

Even a desire that never stops craving
in an innocence that could be called a wish
reflecting the figure of nostalgic days
a bewitching dream, pressing my hands together
I opened the closed door
not knowing that it was a sin
of an unstained radiance
what these eyes reflect is
a broken doll, a vanished price
a future that cannot be severed
in the reality laid bare
a mask that peeled and fell away
what makes a person
is it form, or soul?
seeking the truth
that which creates, that which destroys
forgetting even where zero lies
of the strength carved into the entrusted back
where did the wish break off?
clasping the gripped hands together
if I could protect just one thing
exposed to broad daylight
will the darkness fade away?
even if a sneering awareness gnaws at me
I keep on running
having lost everything
even if no form can be seen
it keeps on breaking
of this lukewarm world
gently, behind it
the pierced sky splits open
it swallowed and spat out
the very radiance of dried tears
is the certain proof
the resonating fates
meet once again
a wounded heart, harboring that wish
creaking armor, two voices that shake it
are set free right here

Ah, the days we dreamed, chasing eternity together
faintly I could hear the footsteps of time
yes, it's now or never — your lingering hand
once I grasp it there's no stopping, the dusk burns and stains

pure desire cracks like a work of glass
and shatters
at the time of parting, even "goodbye" — you surely
you will surely change, won't you

the lie hurts
hey, since when has it been — searching for your gestures, your scent
and alone again, unease assaults me

warped emotions, and hatred is born

exchanging blood, seeking forgiveness
even an illusion is fine, I want to sear the moment in

at the time of parting, even "goodbye" — you surely

The angel's wings I saw as a child
even now, somewhere, you go on searching for them, don't you?

within the solitude I was ordained as a sacrifice

lines: A red ribbon flutters
Draped in the night sky, you are beautiful
sinking in your white fangs
Bewitchment, life, love — partake of them
Hesitation is a mild aphrodisiac
a single drop, and you are caught
From a gaze reeled in close,
a scent that changes in an instant
Innocent silver thread, a maiden's cocoon
before it is defiled,
come now, tear it open
Show me the wound — I'll be dyed in it
Butterfly lace flutters light
Moon and light adorn me like jewels
fingers crawling along my nape
Hidden in the dark woods, secretly
narrowing your golden eyes
To say that you've caught me —
but who is it that's been caught?
In this sealed birdcage,
spread your black wings
and sing for me
The lying mouse recounts:
happiness lies within the light,
and one who is enchanted by the dark
is steeped in a curse and cannot break free
People wither and scatter, life is but a moment
while he goes on eternally
If only we could nestle close together —
a fleeting dream
The solitude I see night after night
You, kissing my fingertips
sorrowful eyes and a sigh
Don't hesitate over anything
Untie the ribbon at my breast
snatch away my heart, touch me deep within
sinking in your white fangs
Bewitchment — I want to keep on falling
Butterfly lace flutters light
Moonlight adorns me
a tongue crawling along my nape
Lost in the dark gloom, secretly
narrowing your golden eyes
Tears running down my cheek
As long as you are here, that is enough
In this sealed birdcage,
spread your black wings
and swear it for me
en.src: booklet PDF — やみのものがたり

Painting on deep red rouge, it stroked my shoulder
Caught in the gap between dream and reality
In exchange for the flame of your life, I'll grant you pleasure
Dance, cherry blossoms; hazy moonlit night, beckoning light
In this quarter that is only beautiful, I grow drunk on solitude
You, beloved and gentle, flicker far away in memory
The phantom granted my wish and shut me away
May my beloved somehow live well, I pray
May those eyes come to see everything once again
Cherry blossoms dance; tearful moonlit night, glowing blossom-light
In this quarter that is only beautiful, the shadow of a corpse
Someday my soul will burn away and I will meet you
Fulfil the pinky-promise vow we exchanged
Dance, cherry blossoms; hazy moonlit night, beckoning light
In this quarter that is only beautiful, I grow drunk on solitude

lines: On the sixteenth-night eve, a black rabbit paired with the rising moon
Across a sky scattered with sugar candy, it bounded about, faded, and passed away
Lattice door, shadow-picture patterns; whispers echo from the old well
A voice calling for someone laments that it wants a head
Strange and eerie, weeping cherry, corpses that flail about
Flaunting a gorgeous dream, the flower of desire blooms out of season

Even lifeless things house a soul and will crawl forth in time

Gazing alone at the hour when demons meet

lines: The silhouette of dusk; a child's song heard far away
Slipping through the deserted alley, the peony lanterns glow
Filling the shadows, the smoke of sandalwood
You call to me from beyond the lattice of the dark
Let me bind your sorrow, passed mouth to mouth
Entwining the fine nectar of your warm tongue's tip
Let me slip you through into the border of waking and dream, please
Touch me, who reaches out fingers longing like a goldfish
To your fingertips, clear and threaded with a wavering heart
From my white breast, the darkness of jealousy stirs
The sparrow's chirp, the timbre of unease
The lure toward solitary poison begins to crave eternity
Let us twine our fingers and play at cat's cradle
Entangling my whole body — tongue and bone and all
Please unravel the intent held in my fingers
Within those beloved arms, hold me, your goldfish
The letter I penned on a moonlit night
Unable to hand it to that person, only my longing swells
Let us lay our bodies together and open tonight's feast
For just an instant, entwine your karma with my sin
Grant me a single finger of your vow, please
Within the lattice, embracing that finger, I, the goldfish, sleep

Hora tsunagatte iru no

Watashi ga kanashii kara
Takusan no negai wo komete
Kimi ni utaimasu

lines: Small words, a warmth that binds us
You smiled and told me it would be all right
What I remember is who I was that day
Unable even to find which way to walk
Even if I try to regret the past,
I cannot take it back
But now, you see, you are here
Let us search for a little happiness
Thank you for the hope to carry me past tomorrow
Thank you for the dream
I did not understand what love meant
and had simply given up on everything
Pouring in all my feelings,
I sing for you
When you are sad, I will whisper
When you are glad, I want to laugh with you
So many roads, so many walls
I want to say don't push yourself too hard, but
On nights you shed tears, look up at the sky
The moon is always watching over you gently
When your heart is heavy and the wounds too deep,
when you feel you might be crushed,
you don't have to endure it
It's all right to run away
Once you let it all out honestly,
it's all right — sleep a little,
for we can meet again in dreams
Hush now, lullaby, hush now
The boy is a good child; go to sleep
Small tears lit by the moonlight
Night is a gentle darkness that grants us peace
Though the bond is unseen for now,
see, we are still connected
Ending it could be done in an instant, but
because it would make me sad,
pouring in all my wishes,
I sing for you
en.src: booklet PDF — 幻恋楼閣談集

lines: 追い詰められた森の深くに
そびえ立つ古びた教会
欲（よく）狂う民が追い立て
足も 腕も 全て 寄越せ（よこせ）と
ああ どうか ここを開けて
貴方の聖地へ 受け入れてください
涙が頬を伝い落つ
幻想と理想を描き 「笑み（えみ）の裏に舞う劣情」
偉大なる女王と崇め「初めての愛をどうぞ私に」
羨望から憎悪は生まれ
誰も彼もが私に罰を望むの
後ろ（うしろ）手に閉めた（しめた）扉の奥
薄灯（うすあかし）り照らされた神父
美しく微笑みながら
懺悔（ざんげ）せよと 祈り捧げる 美しく尊い（とうとい）
その躰の奥 甘美な血と肉と悲鳴が 潜んでいるの
今夜も理性を捨てて 「意識は闇に解け逝く（とけゆく）」

私は何も穢れ（けがれ）ていないのだから
気狂い女王 血と欲に溺れ生き
千の死を楽しんだ
幻想と理想を描き 「笑み（えみ）の裏に舞う劣情」

この身 捧げて堕ちよう

lines: Deep in the forest where I was driven and cornered
a decayed church rises tall
People maddened by greed drive me on
"Hand over your legs, your arms, everything," they cry
Ah, please, open this door
Take me in, into your holy ground
Tears trace down my cheeks and fall
Painting fantasy and ideal — "base lust dancing behind a smile"
Revered as a great queen — "give me your very first love"
From envy, hatred is born
Everyone alike wishes punishment upon me
Beyond the door I closed with hands behind my back
a priest lit by faint lamplight
smiling beautifully all the while
"Confess," he says, offering prayer — beautiful and holy
Deep in that body, sweet blood and flesh and screams lie hidden
Tonight too I cast away reason — "consciousness dissolves into the dark"
The more I drive the silver blade in — "your little breath is still warm"
Look, the devil is inside you
For I am not the least bit defiled
A mad queen, living drowned in blood and lust
I reveled in a thousand deaths
Painting fantasy and ideal — "base lust dancing behind a smile"
Revered as a great queen — "I shall steal away your final moment"
From envy, hatred is born — everyone alike... me...
Wet eyes, sweet fragrance — "like a beautiful monster"
A drop trickling at the breast — "sliding over skin, gorgeous and bewitching"
The devil tempts me again
I will offer up this body and fall
all the way to the end of the dark
en.src: booklet PDF — 罪に濡れた魔女

lines: Dark forest, a wandering shadow — the girl chants a spell
My fingertips tremble, I cannot even breathe
when I think of you
Swaying supple limbs, letting delusion spin round
Neither dark's power nor light can reach me; only madness swells
Surely by tomorrow I can become beautiful
If this longing reaches you, all becomes mine
Golden hair streaming, dance
Once I cast off the last veil
even the gods bow low before my radiant skin
The demon-beast pants
The girl gone mad with unreachable love
lit by the crimson moon
A night unchanged in the least — the curse the girl spat out
Endless loathing turns to hatred
and wounds the heart
That's right — truly there is neither god nor devil
I will overturn the world by my will alone
Let my lapis-blue eyes shine
I'll go to the castle where my beloved prince dwells
Surely he is waiting for me
Guide me, starry sky
And if you would defy me
then let us shatter everything
Golden hair streaming, dance

lines: In this darkly chilled room the night drifts

Crimson eyes wrapped in the scent of roses

Life and death are a solitude of the same fragrance

Please, carry me off with you

Life and death are a solitude of the same fragrance

In this reclining body, consciousness grows distant;
grating noise — I am falling.
Into the dark where I hold another self,
I learn a cruel pain, and tears spill over.
Counting the wounds that multiply, my grieving smile twists;
a spent, soundless wailing melts hollow into the dark.
Before I know it, I nestle close to a sweet Thanatos;
the nearer I draw, the deeper the wounds are gouged.
Instinct aching awake, a sweetly coloring voice,
a loveless tenderness — I fall, on and on, without end.
How many memories must I carve away?
Unable to resist, I give my body up to it.
The act of washing off defilement, meaningless, has warped;
no one will ever teach it — this is all of "me."
To live, to die — not even knowing which,
we overlap and melt away into the dark;
the glass I thrust into the lying grown-ups
casts back a false light and shatters.
To live, to die — not even able to choose,
a thing shared between two, vanishing fleetingly into the void;
my frozen heart refused to know,
for the world I was given is all there is.
Before I know it, I nestle close to a sweet Thanatos;
the nearer I draw, the deeper the wounds are gouged.
Instinct aching awake, a sweetly coloring voice,
a loveless tenderness — I fall, on and on, without end.
